title: Wrong package name in version lookup
detail: The __getattr__ implementation returns the version of the 'werkzeug' package instead of 'jinja2', causing incorrect version reporting and potential failures when the attribute is accessed.

title: Potential AttributeError on non-Failure response
detail: When a non-Failure response object is returned, it may not have a 'flags' attribute, causing an AttributeError when checking "dataloss" in response.flags.
